race.description: Landcruiser King Of The Road Hcp (58+)
race.comment: IHTSAKING (7) gets the nod after two solid Ascot runs in NMW1Y company, the latest a fifth to Alaskan in Saturday company when beaten just over four lengths. He now finds an easier assignment, is third-up, has already placed at this venue, and his recent-form profile looks the most reliable winning platform. PRINCE EPAULETTE (8) is harder to trust after finishing last in the same Ascot race, but he also drops out of Saturday NMW1Y company and his two placings from two starts at this track keep him in the discussion if he rebounds. MISTRESS OF WAR (3) brings the best recent finish, having run third to More Heroic in a CL3 at Ascot, and her record with Laqdar Ramoly is a major positive. OLDEN (4) had excuses when wide in the middle stages at Belmont Park and his two wins this season give him enough substance to improve sharply. FORBIDDEN APPLE (6) has the speed to offset the barrier and is not to be discounted.
